title: SkillCatalogV1
description: Versioned catalog of reusable agents and skills that Feature 3 (Automated Migration Actions) can execute. The planner does not implement or invoke these skills; it only cites them by name in workItems[].agentOrSkill. Assessment scanners populate RepositoryAssessmentV1.availableSkills[] by intersecting this catalog with what a repository actually needs. Skills the planner cites but which are absent from the assessment must be declared in MigrationPlanV1.missingSkills[]. Every catalog entry uses the same shape as RepositoryAssessmentV1 Skill so records are portable between the two contracts.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version tag. Accepts 1.x minor versions.

catalogVersion.description: Monotonic catalog version. Follows the guidance corpus convention YYYY-MM-DD.N.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when this catalog snapshot was authored.

SkillCategory.description: Coarse-grained bucket the skill belongs to. Aligns with Feature 3 subfolders.

Skill.description: One reusable skill. Write-capable skills always require approval before Feature 3 executes them. implementationStatus is set by the catalog audit and gates whether the planner may emit a work item citing this skill.

writeAccess.description: true if this skill can modify a repository or execute non-read operations. Write-capable skills always require approval.

producesGuidanceLinks.description: Optional guidanceIds this skill's output typically cites. Non-authoritative; documentation only.

implementationStatus.description: Honest state of the skill's executor in this repository at catalogVersion time. Set by the catalog audit. 'runnable' means concrete C# code executes this skill end-to-end today. 'declared-only' means the skill is documented but no runner exists; the planner must route such skills into alternatives[] or proposedMissingSkills[], not workItems[]. 'proposed' means the skill is being added in the current iteration and is not yet runnable.

implementedBy.description: Fully qualified C# type or file path that executes the skill end-to-end. Required when implementationStatus is 'runnable'; must be omitted for 'declared-only' and 'proposed'. Not machine-parsed; auditors use it to verify the claim.
